notes: Each entry is one guideline: a short name, its Technique and Form, its base level (for Range Personal, Duration Momentary, Target Individual unless the summary says otherwise), a one-line summary, the book (source, a sourcebooks abbreviation) and printed page, the Target it must have, if any (target), and de_page where the Definitive Edition prints the same guideline. Only guidelines with a level of their own are listed: those the books give as a change to another guideline's level (transparencies, miniatures, altering thoughts) are not. A General guideline (general: true) has no level of its own: the spell's level is the designer's.

entries.name: Free-standing anamorph
entries.summary: An anamorph standing on its own: a vague, shapeless image fooling one sense, which the viewer's mind fills in when he fails a Perception + Awareness roll. +1 magnitude for each further sense, and each one the victim senses lowers his roll by 3. No Mentem requisite. Changing an existing image is Muto Imaginem.

entries.name: Anamorph on an existing image
entries.summary: An anamorph made from something's own species (an existing face, a wearer's look), fooling one sense: the viewer's mind fills in the vague image when he fails a Perception + Awareness roll. +1 magnitude for each further sense, and each one the victim senses lowers his roll by 3 (Magi of Hermes p. 93 files its two-sense bracelet as MuIm, base 2). No Mentem requisite.

entries.name: Synaesthesia
entries.summary: Synaesthesia: turn the species one sense takes in into those another sense does (a scent or warmth made visible). Species of the outer senses turned into those of pain or balance have no effect.

entries.name: Emotion aimed at someone
entries.summary: Create an emotion aimed at one person or thing, an artificial +5 Personality Trait: an extreme one is resisted by an opposed Trait roll against 9, a milder one against 4 + its score.

entries.name: Undirected emotion
entries.summary: Create an undirected leaning toward an emotion (furious at everyone nearby, finding everything said hilarious), resisted as an aimed emotion is.

entries.name: Emotion toward a class
entries.summary: Create an emotion aimed at a whole class of people or things (hatred of everyone wearing a badge, or from one place), resisted as an aimed emotion is.

entries.name: Diminish a mental capability
entries.summary: Diminish one mental capability, as Trust of Childlike Faith does judgement: concentrating, deducing, reading faces, understanding or forming words, writing, judging time, forming memories and the like. Pain, proprioception and balance count as mental capabilities (p. 63).

entries.name: Other states of consciousness
entries.summary: Put a mind in another state of consciousness: animalist (perhaps with an Animal requisite), anaesthetic, daydreaming, dreaming, self-aware, sleepwalking or unconscious, beside awake, asleep and confused.

entries.name: Inscribed memory
entries.summary: Create a memory, an episodic one or an inscribed one such as familiarity with a class of things (a simile), though never an Ability; its detail rests on an Intelligence + Finesse roll against 6.

entries.name: Memory or emotion made solid
entries.summary: Turn a memory or an emotion into a solid object, with a requisite for the object's Form; only its owner feels or recalls it by holding the object.

entries.name: Inclination to belief or indifference
entries.summary: Incline a person to a sort of response, such as belief (more gullible to illusions) or a lack of interest (less likely to remember what he saw).

entries.name: Repair a crafted item
entries.summary: Repair a crafted item, making it as good as new.

entries.name: Inhuman body parts
entries.summary: Add or remove body parts so the target no longer looks human; the parts work unless the spell is made otherwise. Its Target is Part, not Individual.

entries.name: Instant transport
entries.summary: Move a target instantly up to 5 paces: +1 magnitude for 50 paces, +2 for 500, +3 for a league, +4 for seven leagues, +5 to a place you hold an Arcane Connection to.

entries.name: Preserve an Arcane Connection, 1 step
entries.summary: Slow an Arcane Connection's decay, while the spell lasts, as if it were one step higher on the Arcane Connection table; it never lasts for good, nor raises the Penetration multiplier. Range is to the connection.

entries.name: Preserve an Arcane Connection, 2 steps
entries.summary: Slow an Arcane Connection's decay as if it were two steps higher on the table, with the same limits.

entries.name: Preserve an Arcane Connection, 3 steps
entries.summary: Slow an Arcane Connection's decay as if it were three steps higher on the table, with the same limits.

entries.name: Restore a wooden item
entries.summary: Restore a damaged wooden item that was made by hand to the peak of its working life; it can undo decay too, if the damage is light.

entries.name: Ice in a natural shape
entries.summary: Create ice in a natural shape, such as a floe or an icicle.

entries.name: Harmful gas, Light Wound
entries.summary: Turn a gas into a harmful one that causes a Light Wound; a Stamina roll against 6 resists it.

entries.name: Harmful gas, Medium Wound
entries.summary: Turn a gas into a harmful one that causes a Medium Wound; a Stamina roll against 6 resists it.

entries.name: Destroy one aspect of dirt
entries.summary: Destroy one property of dirt, such as its weight or its cohesion.

entries.name: Hurl a stone projectile, +5 damage
entries.summary: Throw a stone as a projectile doing +5 damage, range increment 20 paces: the magic acts only at the throw, so the spell must be aimed but the stone then bypasses Magic Resistance (pp. 35, 38).

entries.name: Hurl a stone projectile, +10 damage
entries.summary: Throw a stone as a projectile doing +10 damage, range increment 20 paces: the magic acts only at the throw, so the spell must be aimed but the stone then bypasses Magic Resistance (pp. 35, 38).

entries.name: Hurl a stone projectile, +15 damage
entries.summary: Throw a stone as a projectile doing +15 damage, range increment 20 paces: the magic acts only at the throw, so the spell must be aimed but the stone then bypasses Magic Resistance (pp. 35, 38).

entries.name: Craft an item from bone (animal)
entries.summary: Bone (animal): Rego craft magic, from Societates' table: an item of Individual size, at Personal Range (Errata p. 59) and Momentary Duration, which lasts. Its quality rests on a Finesse roll (DE p. 307: Perception + Finesse, against the craftsman's Ease Factor + 3).

entries.name: Improve all wounds
entries.summary: Improve every wound the target has by one level of severity.

entries.name: Sustain or suppress magic of a type
entries.summary: General: sustain or suppress spells of one type cast by another (Hermetic Terram magic, Shamanic spirit control) of level up to the Vim spell's level + 2 magnitudes, aimed at the spell itself or at its caster (as Errata pp. 12 and 60 reword it).
